update_log: Baseline initialization of high-frequency Constitutional Amendments, spanning from the First Amendment to the latest structural changes for Polity Static GK.

early_and_foundational_amendments.key_provisions: Added the 9th Schedule to protect land reform laws from judicial review. Added reasonable restrictions to the freedom of speech and expression.
Implemented the States Reorganization Act, abolishing the Part A/B/C/D classification of states. Allowed the appointment of the same person as Governor for two or more states.
Affirmed the power of Parliament to amend any part of the Constitution, including Fundamental Rights. Made it compulsory for the President to give assent to a Constitutional Amendment Bill.

mini_constitution_and_restoration_era.key_provisions: Known as the 'Mini-Constitution'. Added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble. Added Fundamental Duties (Article 51A). Made the President bound by the advice of the cabinet.

Enacted by the Janata Party government to reverse anomalies of the 42nd Amendment. Removed the Right to Property from the list of Fundamental Rights (made it a legal right under Article 300A). Substituted the term 'Internal Disturbance' with 'Armed Rebellion' in respect of National Emergency.
Introduced the Anti-Defection Law and added the 10th Schedule to the Constitution to disqualify MPs/MLAs for defection.
Reduced the voting age from 21 years to 18 years for the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assembly elections.

decentralization_and_administrative_refo.key_provisions: Granted constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions. Added Part IX and the 11th Schedule (containing 29 functional items for Panchayats).
Granted constitutional status to Urban Local Bodies (Municipalities). Added Part IXA and the 12th Schedule (containing 18 functional items).
Made elementary education a Fundamental Right for children between 6 to 14 years of age (Added Article 21A). Added a new Fundamental Duty under Article 51A(k).
Restricted the size of the Council of Ministers to 15% of the total strength of the Lok Sabha / State Legislative Assembly.
Gave a constitutional status and protection to Co-operative Societies. Added Part IXB.

recent_amendments_post_2010.key_provisions: Gave effect to the acquiring of territories by India and transfer of certain territories to Bangladesh (Land Boundary Agreement).
Paved the way for the introduction of the Goods and Services Tax (GST). Added Articles 246A, 269A, and 279A.
Granted constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) under the new Article 338B.
Introduced a 10% reservation for the Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) of society in admissions to educational institutions and government jobs.
Extended the reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies by 10 years. It also ended the reservation of seats for the Anglo-Indian community.
Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam: Mandated a 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies, and the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
